mechanism.claim: At each immutable Bitcoin difficulty retarget, acceleration in epoch-over-epoch difficulty growth reflects strengthening committed mining capacity and maps long BTC; deceleration reflects deteriorating marginal miner capacity and maps short. The transmission is evaluated only outside calm BTC conditions and held for forty-eight hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: BHARR uses the second difference of consensus difficulty at irregular proof-of-work retarget blocks. It is not daily CoinMetrics miner data, block-arrival throughput, fee stress, price momentum, a scheduled macro clock, Gross9, or a prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: prior-24h realized variation rank at confirmed availability must be >=0.35, excluding the calmest 35% while retaining enough immutable retarget events for the frozen support floor.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: retarget blocks arrive roughly biweekly at endogenous block timestamps after six confirmations

authority.difficulty: decode compact nBits from the canonical block header exactly; never use a mutable chart value
authority.dual_replay: height hash, header bytes, nBits, and H+6 confirmation hash/timestamp must agree byte-for-byte
authority.availability: canonical timestamp of block H+6; entry is first exact 5m open strictly after it

features.difficulty_change: log(decoded difficulty at H / decoded difficulty at H-2016)
features.acceleration: current difficulty_change minus previous difficulty_change using H-4032
features.volatility: sum squared BTCUSDT 1m close-to-close log returns over exact 24h ending at the last completed minute strictly before H+6 timestamp
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank at retarget events, at most 52, minimum 26, current excluded, >=0.35

clock.entry: first exact 5m BTCUSDT open strictly after H+6 canonical timestamp
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.selection_basis: new immutable consensus retarget acceleration mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure: dual source integrity/support, Gross9 novelty, sequential economics; no confirmation, rank, threshold, side, hold, transport, or subset repair
